== Summary ==
[[Ed Gartin]], 2021. Head-centred crop of [[:File:Ed Gartin People of Play 2021 banner.jpg]]. Photo: People of Play.

== Source ==
* [https://www.peopleofplay.com/blog/the-big-ideas-are-in-the-bag The BIG IDEAS are in the bag.], Ed Gartin, People of Play blog, 16 April 2021. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027195738/https://www.peopleofplay.com/blog/the-big-ideas-are-in-the-bag Internet Archive]
* Original image: [https://www.peopleofplay.com/uploads/images/20210416020018uWLyuxqX9d.jpg 20210416020018uWLyuxqX9d.jpg] (1493 × 688), the header image of that post.
* Identification: the post is Gartin's own profile Q&A ("by Ed Gartin"), illustrated with this portrait; in it he says Decipher "needed a creative person to manage their art department, so naturally, I jumped at the chance."
* Crop: x 640–1010, y 90–560 of the 1493×688 image, head centred.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced promotional portrait from a public profile that names his work at Decipher, used only to identify Ed Gartin on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the original or harm its market.
